diagnosis.summary: The candidate script runs as a one-shot sequence (period 0) executing the cycle body immediately, then waits 3 MIN. The IR specifies a repeating cycle with a 3 MIN period, meaning the body should execute every 3 minutes indefinitely. The candidate fails to repeat the actions and incorrectly delays at the end instead of looping.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period to 180000 (3 MIN) and replaced the one-shot script with a blocking loop that repeats the body actions (set mode, delay, off) indefinitely. The final delay was removed as it belongs inside the cycle body, not after it.
